title: Languages recognized within a size bound
statement: A language $L$ over Boolean strings belongs to $	extsf{SIZE}(T)$ if there is a family of Boolean circuits, one for each input length, whose gates have fan-in at most two, whose circuit at every length $n$ has size at most $T(n)$, and whose accepted language is exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: Existence of a circuit family with fan-in at most two
Every length-$n$ circuit has size at most $T(n)$
